projects.name: RAGForge
projects.description: Full-stack Retrieval-Augmented Generation application that turns custom documents into an accurate, grounded, citation-backed AI assistant with hybrid search, cross-encoder BGE reranking, and session isolation.
highlights: Ingests documents from PDFs, Word files, text files, markdown, and web URLs.
Implements hybrid search combining dense semantic similarity (sentence-transformers) and sparse BM25 keyword matching.
Re-ranks retrieved chunks using a cross-encoder model (BGE reranker) before sending the best passages to the Groq LLM.
Provides session-isolated document knowledge bases and conversations without requiring user login.
Includes built-in evaluation metrics for retrieval and generation (MRR, Recall@k, NDCG, faithfulness) with pytest suite.
